page.content:
World-serpent who encircles Midgard and will poison Thor.

How Jormungandr connects

  • Character: Loki — Loki is father of Jormungandr.
  • Character: Thor — Thor and Jormungandr are fated to kill one another.
  • Location: Midgard — Jormungandr encircles Midgard in the outer ocean.

What is Jormungandr?

Jormungandr, cast into the ocean by Odin, grows until he grips his own tail. Thor fishes for him and will kill him at Ragnarok, walking nine paces before falling to the venom.

Key threads lead to Loki, Thor and Midgard.
